segments.speaker: narrator
segments.text: What do the Greek island of Ikaria, the Nicoya peninsula in Costa Rica, and the island of Okinawa in Japan have in common? The answer is that, together with Loma Linda in California and Sardinia in Italy, they are the five so-called Blue Zones, the best places in the world to live if you want to have a long and healthy life. Many people there live until they are one hundred or more. So what are their secrets?
